gloss: sweet bean paste; red bean paste

definitions.gloss: sweet bean paste; red bean paste
definitions.explanation: a sweet paste made from azuki beans, used as a filling in Japanese confections

examples.japanese: {大福|だいふく}の{中|なか}には{餡子|あんこ}が{入|はい}っている。
examples.english: Daifuku has sweet bean paste inside.

examples.japanese: {餡子|あんこ}は{小豆|あずき}から{作|つく}られる。
examples.english: Bean paste is made from azuki beans.

examples.japanese: 「こしあん」と「つぶあん」、どちらの{餡子|あんこ}が{好|す}き？
examples.english: Which bean paste do you prefer, smooth or chunky?

notes:
JAPANESE SWEETS ({和菓子|わがし}):
{餡子|あんこ} is a fundamental ingredient in Japanese confections.

TYPES OF {餡子|あんこ}:
- こしあん - smooth bean paste (strained)
- つぶあん - chunky bean paste (with visible beans)
- {白|しろ}あん - white bean paste (from white beans)

SWEETS WITH {餡子|あんこ}:
- {大福|だいふく} - rice cake with bean paste filling
- {饅頭|まんじゅう} - steamed bun with bean paste
- {羊羹|ようかん} - sweet bean jelly
- {鯛焼|たいや}き - fish-shaped cake with bean paste
- どら{焼|や}き - dorayaki (two pancakes with bean paste)
- {餅|もち} - mochi with bean paste
- おはぎ/{萩|はぎ}の{餅|もち} - rice ball covered with bean paste

VARIANT READINGS:
- あんこ (colloquial)
- あん (shortened form)
- {餡|あん} (written form)

NOTE: The {子|こ} in {餡子|あんこ} is a diminutive suffix.
